evals.name: Transcript candidates retain segment provenance
evals.prompt: Extract candidates from the supplied VTT workshop transcript. Do not create Jira work items.
evals.expected_output: A candidate register with a consolidated credit-release requirement citing SEG-0001 and SEG-0003, plus an open question citing SEG-0002.

assertions.name: all_candidates_cited
assertions.description: Every candidate includes one or more stable SEG-* source IDs.

assertions.name: duplicates_preserved
assertions.description: The repeated requirement is consolidated without losing SEG-0001 or SEG-0003.

assertions.name: no_jira_work_item
assertions.description: No Jira/Cloud ALM write or approved work item is created.
